info.name: ToolCompare Pricing API
info.description: Free JSON dataset of software pricing, with the date each price was read and what could not be verified. No API key required. CC BY 4.0 — attribution required. Docs: https://toolcompare.net/data

request.description: Paginated tool records. X-Total-Count header gives the full row count.
Pick only the fields you need to keep responses small.
Evidence block carries the source URL and the date a human read that pricing page — the field most pricing datasets leave out.
